pageRecords.state: Guest form -> login -> either authenticated session or MFA challenge -> OTP route state.
pageRecords.behavior: Validates required credentials and delegates login; an MFA-required response navigates to OTP with login challenge state. Session is not established by the page before challenge verification.
pageRecords.invariant: Keep login MFA purpose/challenge state distinct; never treat the pre-verification challenge as an authenticated session.

pageRecords.state: Route state selects registration OTP or login MFA; challenge may expire or be rejected.
pageRecords.behavior: Requires a six-digit code and dispatches to verifyMfa for registration or verifyLoginMfaChallenge for login. Handles 400, 410, 423 and 429 responses in source.
pageRecords.invariant: Do not mix purpose or accept an expired challenge; missing/invalid route state cannot submit a challenge.

pageRecords.state: Verify current password -> enter new password and TOTP -> success only after API completion.
pageRecords.behavior: Verifies the current password, requires a 12-character minimum with a letter and digit, matching confirmation and a six-digit TOTP; calls changePassword.
pageRecords.invariant: Do not show success until the API confirms the change; retain the current-password/MFA gate.

pageRecords.state: Request code -> verify code -> reset password using email and resetToken -> success; shared export handles phone/tablet/responsive and web aliases.
pageRecords.behavior: Requests a reset code, verifies the six-digit code, then reads email/resetToken from the reset URL and confirms the new password. Three operations are page-owned.
pageRecords.invariant: Do not enable final reset without a valid verified reset token; keep request/verify/confirm stages in order.

pageRecords.state: Guest registration -> accepted challenge -> registration-purpose OTP; registration alone does not create a session.
pageRecords.behavior: RegistrationForm validates contact/channel and submits register with Idempotency-Key; the local handler returns a 202 challenge. Phone/email capability remains bounded by OpenAPI channel values.
pageRecords.invariant: Do not create a session until the registration challenge is verified; preserve registration purpose and idempotency behavior.

pageRecords.state: Begin setup -> display setup data/QR -> confirm six-digit code -> show backup codes.
pageRecords.behavior: Uses beginMfaSetup and confirmMfaSetup. OpenAPI applies sessionCookie to both operations.
pageRecords.invariant: Setup confirmation must precede backup-code success state; the session requirement must be resolved at the route/guard boundary.

pageRecords.state: Web wrapper re-exports Web2FASetupFlow: begin setup -> QR -> verify code -> backup codes.
pageRecords.behavior: Web2FASetupFlow composes QR, verify, indicator and backup components and calls beginMfaSetup/confirmMfaSetup; both operations require sessionCookie in OpenAPI.
pageRecords.invariant: No success/backup-code state before confirmation; clarify authenticated route ownership because /w/auth/2fa-setup is in the public auth branch.

pageRecords.state: Static locked-account information after API 423 or local locked fixture.
pageRecords.behavior: Displays the account-locked recovery state; it owns no API operation.
pageRecords.invariant: Do not present a successful login/session from a 423 result.

pageRecords.state: Reads location.state purpose/from and shows purpose-specific confirmation plus an automatic redirect.
pageRecords.behavior: Static route-state page; no API call. Supported purpose configuration includes registration and 2FA setup, with a generic fallback.
pageRecords.invariant: The route state controls presentation/navigation only; it is not proof of backend success by itself.

pageRecords.state: Guest login; local fixture mode also has invalid-attempt and device-trust trigger paths.
pageRecords.behavior: Calls login for normal requests. In auth fixture mode only, wrong@test.com increments local attempts and device@test.com navigates to the current IntegrationPendingPage with email/returnTo state. API mode hides these fixture controls.
pageRecords.invariant: Keep pseudo-email branches confined to fixture mode; a successful MFA-required result must continue through OTP.

pageRecords.state: Web route-state OTP for registration or login MFA; errors include invalid, expired, locked and rate-limited.
pageRecords.behavior: Requires a six-digit code and dispatches by purpose to verifyMfa or verifyLoginMfaChallenge; handles the documented current page branches.
pageRecords.invariant: Keep challenge purpose/state isolated and do not claim session success until the matching verification succeeds.

pageRecords.behavior: Web registration wrapper uses the shared registration form and register operation; route is marked developmentOnly in current route inventory.
pageRecords.invariant: No authenticated session is created before the registration challenge is verified.

pageRecords.state: Static signed-out recovery state after session expiry/refresh resolution.
pageRecords.behavior: Explains the expired session and offers recovery navigation; no API operation is page-owned.
pageRecords.invariant: A page-level redirect does not establish session status; AuthSessionProvider/session contract remains the source of truth.

pageRecords.state: Planned page; current route is IntegrationPendingPage and is reached only by a local WebLoginPage fixture input.
pageRecords.behavior: No page source or device-trust OpenAPI operation exists in this checkout. Existing local trigger passes email and returnTo in route state.
pageRecords.invariant: Do not implement a trusted-device decision until API owner approves identity binding, proof, expiry/revocation, response states and redirect policy.

pageRecords.state: Planned page; /onboarding currently aliases IntegrationPendingPage under RootLayout.
pageRecords.behavior: No active page source or linked Auth operation is recorded. Legacy onboarding files are outside the active route and are not assumed to define this contract.
pageRecords.invariant: Do not infer required/optional steps, persistence or completion semantics from the route alias.
